project.title: From the first click to the result.
project.intro: A small demo to explore the whole application: interface, API, persistence and failure recovery. Every decision has a place in the code.

purpose.title: A project you can walk through.
purpose.body: Lucky Canopy brings together a personal portfolio and a three-reel minigame. It demonstrates a responsive interface and follows the data to the server, with responsibilities that are easy to find and explain.
purpose.scope: Bets of 10, 25 or 50 virtual credits. No registration, payments or real money. Four symbols and one winning line keep the scope small.

roles.pages: Pages, layout and endpoints. TypeScript describes contracts between the parts.
roles.routing: Machine, Rules and Examples panels inside /play, using memory history.
roles.data: Query caches the confirmed session; Axios handles HTTP requests.
roles.events: Signals session changes. On connection or reconnection, the client queries the API.
roles.database: Transactions, session locking and persistence. LISTEN/NOTIFY communicates changes between processes.
roles.interface: Visual tokens, responsive layouts and local controls composed with Radix.
roles.validation: Runtime validation of API inputs, responses and events.
roles.language: Copy, accessible messages and metadata in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
roles.delivery: Automated tests, validation before committing and a continuous integration workflow.

flow.title: One round, five steps.

intent.title: Record the intention
intent.body: A click creates an identifier and stores the pending request in this tab before sending it. A new round stays blocked.

request.title: Send through the API
request.body: The mutation uses Axios. The endpoint identifies the session through the HTTP-only cookie and validates the input with Zod.

transaction.title: Confirm in the database
transaction.body: The service checks the balance and identifier. Drawing, calculation and persistence happen in one transaction, with the session locked.

confirmation.title: Receive confirmation
confirmation.body: The response updates the cache. After COMMIT, the database also notifies Socket.IO; the event can trigger an HTTP query.

presentation.title: Reveal the round
presentation.body: The reels present the received symbols. The previous balance, payout and history remain visible until the animation finishes, then update together.

flow.caption: The server determines the result. The animation presents it. Events received during a spin wait until it finishes before synchronizing.

architecture.title: Organization with concrete examples.
architecture.body: One repository, organized by feature. Interface, transport, rules and storage have separate responsibilities. Open an example to find its implementation.
architecture.source: Files on develop · open in a new tab

composition.title: Component composition
composition.body: GameBoard combines reels, bet selection, messages and history. Each part receives data and actions, allowing presentation changes without moving game rules into the screen.

service.title: Service and pure functions
service.body: The service coordinates the round and its persistence. In rules.ts, calculation depends only on its arguments, making balance and payout tests deterministic.

repository.title: A specific repository
repository.body: The contract describes the session and round operations the service needs. storage.ts implements those operations in PostgreSQL and contains transactions and SQL queries.

dependencies.title: Explicit dependencies
dependencies.body: The service receives a repository, a drawing function and an identifier generator. The runtime supplies real implementations; tests supply controlled versions, without a dependency injection container.

decisions.title: What happens outside the happy path?

presentation.title: Confirmed data and when to display it
presentation.body: The cache receives confirmation immediately. A visual snapshot of the previous session prevents the balance and history from appearing early. Reduced motion skips the animation wait; sound starts off.

routing.title: Two routers with clear boundaries
routing.body: Next.js controls /, /play and /project. TanStack Router only handles the game's internal panels. Memory history preserves the workspace but does not offer direct links to individual panels.

recovery.title: A timeout is not a cancellation
recovery.body: A lost response is recovered through GET using the same identifier. A 404 can precede confirmation: the request stays pending and no new bet is sent automatically. Version and generation protect against old responses and resets in another tab.

quality.title: Verify before integrating.
quality.body: Tests cover rules, HTTP contracts, recovery and presentation. Integration uses test PostgreSQL to verify concurrency, rollback, idempotency and events between instances.
quality.check: Lint, formatting, types, tests and build. Husky runs this command before normal commits.
quality.integration: Runs database tests with TEST_DATABASE_URL and isolated temporary schemas.
quality.delivery: The GitHub Actions workflow is in the repository. Working branches start from develop and return through a PR; main is the production branch. Automatic Vercel delivery will be configured in the deployment stage.

limits.title: Limits that guide what comes next.

items.events: LISTEN/NOTIFY does not store missed events. Reconnection recovers state through HTTP; a silently lost update in another tab may require a manual session refresh.
items.scale: Atomicity was tested between connections and processes. This does not measure traffic capacity. Each events instance keeps a direct database connection; additional layers should follow an observed need.
items.hosting: Integration was validated locally with Neon. Socket.IO function discovery, routing and HTTPS/WSS on Vercel still need hosted validation. Final quality review and documentation are also part of the next deliveries.

repository.title: Continue through the code.
repository.body: The examples above link to real files on the develop branch. Explore the service, components and tests to follow the decisions through the implementation.

interface.title: Interface and responsiveness
interface.description: One column on mobile and more room for the composition on desktop. Theme, navigation and visible focus share the same components throughout the application.

data.title: Application data and states
data.description: Sessions, balances and rounds are confirmed by the server. Axios handles requests, and TanStack Query keeps remote state separate from animation.

motion.title: Interactions and animation
motion.description: The reels display the confirmed result in sequence, with 260 ms between stops. Text and reduced motion keep the experience accessible.

game.description: Three reels, four symbols and one winning line. Explore the interface and the demo rules.

sound.unavailable: Audio could not be enabled in this browser. The interface remains available without sound.

rules.title: Combinations
rules.intro: The game concept uses 1,000 virtual credits and bets of 10, 25 or 50. Three identical symbols on the centre line form a match. There are no payments, withdrawals or monetary value.
rules.description: Display values for the selected bet: {{bet}} credits.
rules.note: The payout is the total credited for the round; the bet is deducted once. No match means no prize. There is no claim about probabilities or RTP.

reset.title: Reset this example?
reset.description: Only the visual example will return to 1,000 credits and an empty history. No server session or round will be changed.

examples.title: Interface examples
examples.description: Local scenarios with fixed values, no bets, random draws or round connection. Animate replays a known preview; it does not calculate a new result. Changing the scenario interrupts the previous animation.

unavailable.title: No session in this example
unavailable.body: This frame represents the interface before a session exists. Data remains unknown; no round will be sent.

loading.title: Loading demo…
loading.body: Waiting for the data needed to display the session. Starting another round remains blocked.

ready.title: Ready to explore
ready.body: Fixed example bet: {{bet}} credits. The animation shows a known scenario without sending a bet.

spinning.title: Spinning…
spinning.body: An example animation is in progress. Wait for all three reels to stop; the values have not yet been replaced by the final snapshot.

stopping.title: Presenting the result…
stopping.body: The reels stop in sequence. The complete snapshot will appear when the animation finishes.

win.title: Match! +{{prize}} credits
win.body: Three flowers on the line in this example. The displayed prize is the total credited for a bet of {{bet}} credits.

loss.title: No match this round
loss.body: This snapshot illustrates a round with no prize and a bet of {{bet}} credits. No new bet was placed.

insufficient.title: Insufficient balance
insufficient.body: The example has {{balance}} credits and a bet of {{bet}}. In an available session, choose a smaller bet or reset when no round is pending.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: This scenario represents an unavailable connection. A new round should wait until the session is restored.

verifying.title: Checking result…
verifying.body: The result is not confirmed yet. Do not start another round while the check is pending.

failed.title: The result could not be confirmed
failed.body: The displayed value is the last reference, not a guarantee of an up-to-date balance. Check the same result before continuing, without resending the bet.

api.resetDescription: Your balance will return to 1,000 fictional credits and the displayed history will be cleared. No real money is involved. The reset is only confirmed after the server responds.
api.pending: The result is still unconfirmed. Check it or try to complete the same request. No new bet will be created.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: The request was rejected. Refresh the session before continuing.
errors.SESSION_REQUIRED: Start the demo to receive your fictional credits.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Start a new demo to continue.
errors.SESSION_CHANGED: The session changed in another tab. Refresh the data before continuing.
errors.SESSION_LIMIT: This session has reached its operation limit. Wait for it to expire before starting another.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: There are not enough credits for this bet. Refresh the session and choose a lower bet or reset.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request could not be reconciled. Refresh the session before continuing.
errors.ROUND_NOT_FOUND: The round has not been found yet. This does not confirm the request was cancelled.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: The request origin was rejected. Reopen the demo using the site address.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The request format was rejected. Refresh the page.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The request exceeded the allowed size. Refresh the page.
errors.GAME_UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable. Wait and check again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The connection failed or timed out. The displayed balance is the last confirmation received.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The response could not be validated. Check the session before continuing.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Recovery data could not be saved in this tab. Allow temporary storage to play safely.

realtime.reconnecting: Reconnecting live updates… You can keep playing.
